hosea.14.p1.b1.text: Return, O Israel, to the LORD your God, for you have stumbled by your iniquity.

hosea.14.p1.b2.text: Take away all our iniquity and receive us graciously, that we may present the fruit of our lips.

hosea.14.p1.b3.text: Assyria will not save us, nor will we ride on horses. We will never again say, ‘Our gods!’ to the work of our own hands.

hosea.14.p1.b4.text: I will heal their apostasy; I will freely love them, for My anger has turned away from them.

hosea.14.p2.b1.text: I will be like the dew to Israel; he will blossom like the lily and take root like the cedars of Lebanon.

hosea.14.p2.b2.text: His shoots will sprout, and his splendor will be like the olive tree, his fragrance like the cedars of Lebanon.

hosea.14.p2.b3.text: O Ephraim, what have I to do anymore with idols?

hosea.14.p2.b4.text: I am like a flourishing cypress; your fruit comes from Me.

hosea.14.p2.b5.text: For the ways of the LORD are right, and the righteous walk in them but the rebellious stumble in them.
